title: Privacy-Preserving Clustering Algorithm and Parameter Selection for Collaborative Population Stratification Using Distributed PCA
abstract: arXiv:2611.18925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a privacy-preserving selection layer for collaborative population stratification workflows, enabling an honest-but-curious server to recommend a strong clustering algorithm-hyperparameter configuration from privacy protected shares. Instead of using a fixed workflow such as PCA followed by K-Means with a preset number of clusters, the framework compares multiple clustering methods and parameter settings under privacy constraints. To avoid relying on a public reference basis, we construct a shared low-dimensional representation through a distributed-PCA (DPCA) procedure in which each party computes local top-$r$ principal-component information and the server aggregates only low-rank summaries to recover a global basis. Building on this representation, the framework supports three LDP-protected pipelines: PCA then Noise, Noise then PCA, and Noise-Only. translated_title: 基于分布式PCA的协同种群分层隐私保护聚类算法与参数选择
translated_abstract: 我们为协同种群分层工作流提出了一种隐私保护的选择层，使诚实但好奇的服务器能够从隐私保护的数据份额中推荐性能优异的聚类算法-超参数配置。不同于使用固定工作流（如先进行PCA再用预设聚类数的K-Means），该框架在隐私约束下比较多种聚类方法和参数设置。为避免依赖公开的参考基准，我们通过分布式PCA（DPCA）过程构建共享的低维表示，其中各方计算本地的前r个主成分信息，而服务器仅聚合低秩摘要以恢复全局基。基于该表示，框架支持三种受本地差分隐私（LDP）保护的流水线：先PCA后加噪、先加噪后PCA以及仅加噪。服务器使用内部评估指标来评估聚类方法和参数设置。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种隐私保护框架，通过分布式PCA与本地差分隐私技术，让服务器在不接触原始数据的情况下自动为协同种群分层选择最优的聚类算法及其超参数配置。
